items.headline: Sunnyvale duplex at 536 Hawthorn Avenue could become three townhomes
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 26 study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish a 1,360 sq ft duplex on a 0.29-acre R-3 lot and build three townhome-style condominiums in one two-story building. The application also includes a tentative parcel map to split the lot into three.

items.headline: Citywide residential parking rules rewrite sought continuance to November 9
items.summary: The October 26 Planning Commission agenda listed a request to continue to November 9, 2026, a proposed ordinance that would repeal and replace Sunnyvale's parking chapter (19.46) for residential off-street parking. It would also amend the Downtown, Lawrence Station, and El Camino Real specific plan districts and the Dual Urban Opportunity Housing chapter. The agenda shows only the continuance request, not a confirmed delay.

items.headline: Pruneyard asks to extend office tower deadlines to 2031
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on a request from the Pruneyard Center Association to extend the phasing deadlines for Phases 3 and 4 to December 31, 2031. Those phases include a five-story office building, parking structure expansions and additional commercial buildings. The request also covers extending the tentative parcel map, which would create a fourth parcel for the office building. The Planning Commission recommended that the council approve the request.

items.headline: Council agenda listed Tiburcio Vásquez gravesite historic designation
items.summary: The October 20 special meeting agenda listed consideration of a Historic Resource Designation for the Tiburcio Vásquez gravesite in Santa Clara Mission Cemetery. The item had been deferred from August 25 and September 15, 2026.

items.headline: Council agenda listed data center moratorium and NDA ban requests
items.summary: The October 20 agenda listed two Councilmember Hardy requests, both deferred from October 6. One asked for a staff update within 30 days on how power is allocated to large electrical users such as data centers, with a possible moratorium on new stand-alone data centers. The other asked to discuss a policy barring the city from signing non-disclosure agreements with stand-alone data centers.

items.headline: Council agenda listed FIFA risk analysis disclosures investigation update
items.summary: The October 20 agenda included an update on the FIFA Risk Analysis Disclosures Investigation, listed both for the 5:30 PM special meeting and in the later agenda.

items.headline: Councilmember Park's apartment parking request was on the agenda again
items.summary: The October 20 agenda listed Councilmember Park's request to consider how apartment residents can park in or near their complexes without being ticketed or towed. It had been deferred from September 22 and October 6.

items.headline: Council agenda: Cubberley child care partnership letter and $15,000 for neighbor grants
items.summary: The October 19 City Council agenda listed approval of a letter of intent with Palo Alto Community Child Care to collaborate on a long-term public-private partnership for expanded child care at the Cubberley site. It also listed $15,000 from Council Contingency for the Know Your Neighbors Grant Program and a Caltrain presentation on a framework for a "No External Funding Scenario."
